presentation: Source board with nearest-neighbor magnification; exact native files retained. Root UI resized board; this is semantic inspection, not native legibility qualification.
observations: Git brand mark has a containing diamond silhouette, unlike the node and connector operation symbols.
Branches and fork each have three terminal nodes but differ in connector symmetry.
Commit-vertical contains one node on a vertical line; pull-request has three nodes and a returning arrow.
Filled commit source is missing and remains explicitly unfilled in source inventory.
decision: Agree with proposed split of Git brand mark; retain operation grouping as development proposal with distinct semantic meanings and unresolved aliases. No automatic reuse.
